function makeLabelCanvas(name, ink): HTMLCanvasElement | null

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene.ts:159

Draws a dir-name label onto a fresh 2d canvas — shared by the three.js sprite arm (CanvasTexture) and the scene3d arm (createImageBitmap → texture upload). Returns null when 2d canvas is unavailable (happy-dom, exotic runtimes) so the scene still mounts label-free.

Parameters

name

string

Folder name drawn on the label.

ink

string

Theme ink color resolved from the canvas' computed style.

Returns

HTMLCanvasElement | null
